1. 金融 (Kin'yū) - This is the word for "finance" in Japanese.
2. 資産 (Shāsatsu) - This means "assets" or "capital," and can refer to things like money, property, or other valuable resources.
3. 債 (Kin) - In Japanese, this word means "debt" or "loan."
4. 利益 (Rikaisya) - This phrase means "profit" or "income," and can refer to the money you make from a business or investment.
5. 損益 (Kōkyō) - This is the opposite of "profit," and refers to any losses or expenses incurred by a business.
6. 財務 (Zaifu) - This means "financial affairs" or "money management."
7. 会計 (Kaeiketsu) - In Japanese, this word means "accounting" or "bookkeeping."
8. 経理 (Keiryō) - This phrase refers to the management of a business's finances and operations.
9. 資本 (Shahon) - This means "capital" in Japanese, and can refer to the money or other resources used to start or run a business.
10. 投資 (Tsukushi) - This word means "investment," and can refer to putting money into something with the hope of earning a profit.
